// diagnostic

E0617

This scope member has the wrong arguments.

What

This scope member has the wrong arguments.

Why

Each member has a fixed shape: `.timeout(500ms)` takes one duration value, `.setup`/`.expect_fail` take none, `.skip` takes an optional reason string.

Fix

Match the member's shape, e.g. `.timeout(500ms) { … }`, `.timeout(wait) { … }`, or `.skip("reason") { … }`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0617: tests/ui/scope_member_timeout_bad_arg.stderr.

Error [E0617]: `.timeout` needs exactly one duration
  --> tests/ui/scope_member_timeout_bad_arg.jet:6:13
    |
  6 |     .timeout("soon") {
    |             ^^^^^^^^
 Why: the region must complete within a time budget, written as a duration value
 Fix: write `.timeout(500ms) { … }` or bind that value first (`ns`/`us`/`ms`/`s`/`min`/`h`/`d`)
